text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if the data used to train AI contains unfair patterns, the system may make biased decisions, for example in hiring or loans. Fairness means we must check algorithms regularly and correct any prejudice. Privacy is another issue, since AI often collects personal information, and users need clear control over their data. Transparency is essential too—people should understand how and why a system arrives at its results. Finally, responsible AI development requires companies and governments to work together, following strict guidelines and being accountable for any harm caused. Only then can we trust this powerful technology.
